kills.property: For every input, the reference contract's owner() returns the exact stored owner (the address set at construction), whereas the mutant returns a different deterministically-derived address; thus owner() should equal the originally stored owner for all calls — the mutant violates this for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: owner() returns the stored _owner XORed with a constant, producing a different address result deterministically.

kills.property: For every input the reference contract's owner() returns the externally set owner (the deployer), never the contract's own address; the mutant breaks this because it returns address(this) instead.
kills.change_summary: owner() now returns address(this), so the contract reports itself as the owner.

kills.property: For any caller the reference contract's owner() always returns the stored owner address set at construction/transferOwnership, whereas the mutant returns the caller (msg.sender) so for some caller addresses the returned value differs.
kills.change_summary: owner() now returns _msgSender() instead of the stored _owner, changing the returned owner to the current caller.

kills.property: For any caller, the deployed contract's owner() must return the deployer address (the Context _msgSender() at construction); the mutant that always returns address(0) violates this for any input where deployer != address(0).
kills.change_summary: owner() now returns address(0) unconditionally, causing owner() to always report the zero address.

kills.property: For any externally-observable call context (any msg.sender and any caller contract), calling C.owner() via a low-level call initiated by a caller contract returns the originally stored owner (the deployer) — the mutant returns tx.origin instead and thus will differ when the caller contract is invoked by an EOA different from the deployer; the test fuzzes the EOA caller so the mutant fails for some EOA values.
kills.change_summary: owner() now returns tx.origin instead of the stored _owner, exposing the externally-owned originator as the owner.
